replication_state_before_positions.bson is the replication_state.bson that
Cluster.saveAppliedState wrote on the starting tree of the positions work
(main at fb90f7f), for:

  applied position     node-a:7000 -> 41
  qualified snapshot   node-a:7000, db1/users -> 30
  bare-name snapshot   node-b:7000, logs -> 12 (written before snapshot positions were qualified by database)

It was produced by a throwaway test in package server on fb90f7f with no other
edit: newStateTestCluster, markApplied, raise on seededThrough, legacySeeded set
by hand (recordSeeded writes qualified positions only), saveAppliedState, then
the bytes of replicationStatePath() copied out. 135 bytes.
